resources.string: A phone wallet never stores the card number. The token service gives it a token, a different number that only the vault can map back to the card, and keys that last a few taps.
Terminals and receipts see only the token. A leaked token is useless online and can be switched off without reissuing the card.
When the taps run out the wallet must ask the token service for a new key. The new key retires the old one, so a copied key stops working.
Pay with it on the payment terminal screen: choose Phone wallet. The issuer host screen shows how the bank maps the token back.
